python << 'EOF'
import parse

print("=== R1: Trailing newline handling ===")
tests_r1 = [
    ('hello\n', 'hello\n'),
    ('{}\n', 'world\n'),
    ('{:d}\n', '42\n'),
    ('{name}\n', 'test\n'),
]

for fmt, text in tests_r1:
    r = parse.parse(fmt, text)
    print(f"parse({repr(fmt)}, {repr(text)}) = {r}")

print("\n=== R2: Digit field numbering with type conversions ===")
tests_r2 = [
    ('{0:d}', '42', (42,)),
    ('{0:d}', '-42', (-42,)),
    ('{0:x}', 'ff', (255,)),
    ('{0:b}', '1010', (10,)),
    ('{0:o}', '77', (63,)),
    ('{0:f}', '3.14', (3.14,)),
    ('{}', 'hello', ('hello',)),  # Should still work as before
    ('{:d}', '42', (42,)),  # Should still work as before
]

all_pass = True
for item in tests_r2:
    if len(item) == 3:
        fmt, text, expected = item
        r = parse.parse(fmt, text)
        if r is None or r.fixed != expected:
            print(f"FAIL: parse({repr(fmt)}, {repr(text)}) = {r} (expected fixed={expected})")
            all_pass = False
        else:
            print(f"OK: parse({repr(fmt)}, {repr(text)}) = {r}")
    else:
        fmt, text = item
        r = parse.parse(fmt, text)
        print(f"parse({repr(fmt)}, {repr(text)}) = {r}")

if all_pass:
    print("\nR2 tests: ALL PASSED")
else:
    print("\nR2 tests: SOME FAILED")
EOF
